items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane: Expected to undergo wrist surgery
items.description:
Lane (wrist) is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days, potentially as soon as Wednesday, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dylan Sampson: Lands on injured reserve
items.description:
Sampson (knee) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Omar Cooper: Considered week-to-week
items.description:
Cooper (ankle) is "week-to-week," and the hope is he returns "within the next four weeks," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Could have four-week timeline
items.description:
Darnold (glute) is "looking at about a four-week return to play" but could return "a little bit sooner than that," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Xavier Worthy: Opens season with three catches
items.description:
Worthy secured three of six targets for 18 yards in the Chiefs' 31-10 win over the Broncos on Monday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
